title: Business growth associate
description:
Business Growth Associate (BGA)
  
  
Job Type: Full-time
  
Experience: Freshers & Experienced Candidates
  
Location: Kolkata, West Bengal
  
  
About the Role
  
  
We are looking for a motivated and result-oriented Business growth Associate to join our team. The candidate will be responsible for identifying business opportunities, connecting with potential clients, building relationships, and contributing to the company’s growth.

- Connect with prospective clients and understand their requirements.
  
- Conduct product/service presentations and explain offerings effectively.
  
- Follow up with leads and maintain regular communication with prospects.
  
- Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and business partners.
  
- Maintain and update lead and customer information in CRM/records.

- Prepare basic reports on leads, follow-ups, conversions, and business activities.
  
- Stay updated on industry trends and competitor activities.

- Freshers are welcome to apply.

- Strong interpersonal and convincing skills.
  
- Willingness to learn and work in a target-oriented environment.
  
- Basic knowledge of MS Office/Google Workspace.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
- Degree in BBA, B.Com, BA, B.Sc., or a related field.
  
- Previous experience in sales, business development, telecalling, or client handling.
  
- Interest in EdTech, AI, or technology.
  
- Familiarity with CRM tools, lead generation, or sales processes.
  
- Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  
  
What We’re Looking For
  
  
- Self-motivated and proactive individuals.
  
- Confident communicators who are comfortable interacting with clients.
  
- Candidates with a growth mindset and willingness to take initiative.
  
- Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with a team.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem.
  
  
With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business-to-business technology experts.
  
  
Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a results-oriented
**Account Manager - Sales**
to manage and grow customer accounts, drive revenue, and build long-term business relationships within the IT Distribution ecosystem. The role involves managing existing customers, identifying new business opportunities, driving solution sales, and collaborating with internal teams, channel partners, and technology vendors to achieve business objectives.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess strong account management skills, a customer-centric approach, and the ability to drive revenue growth through consultative selling and strategic relationship management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Account Management**

* Manage and develop relationships with assigned customer accounts.
* Build strong engagement with key decision-makers and stakeholders.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.
* Develop account plans and growth strategies to maximize business opportunities.

**Sales & Business Development**

* Achieve assigned sales, revenue, and gross margin targets.
* Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling within existing accounts.
* Acquire new customers and expand business within target markets.

* Conduct regular customer meetings and business reviews.
* Understand customer business needs and recommend appropriate technology solutions.
* Build strong customer relationships to ensure retention and long-term growth.
* Address customer concerns and coordinate internal resources for timely resolution.

* Promote and position the company's IT products, solutions, and services.
* Work closely with Product Managers and Pre-Sales teams to develop customer-centric solutions.

* Work closely with channel partners, system integrators, and resellers to drive business growth.
* Collaborate with OEMs and technology vendors to identify business opportunities and leverage vendor programs.

* Track and manage opportunities through CRM systems.

* Stay updated on technology trends, competitor activities, and market developments.
* Gather customer feedback and market insights to support business growth strategies.

* Collaborate with Sales, Product Management, Pre-Sales, Operations, Marketing, and Finance teams.
* Ensure smooth order processing, delivery coordination, and post-sales support.
* Drive customer satisfaction through effective internal and external stakeholder management.

title: Package Consultant-Oracle Logistics OTM

Master's Degree

* Packaged Solution Expertise: Experience with applying packaged solution expertise to meet client needs, providing guidance on best practices and solution implementation.
* Consulting Skills: Experience with utilizing consulting skills to identify business opportunities and develop solutions that drive desired business outcomes for clients.
* Oracle SCM Cloud Suite Knowledge: Experience with the Oracle Cloud Supply Chain Management suite, including business areas like OTM and Order Management.
* Business Outcome Development: Experience with working with clients to identify and prioritize business outcomes, developing and implementing solutions that achieve these goals.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Exposure to Industry Trends: Familiarity with emerging trends and technologies in supply chain management and cloud-based solutions, enabling innovative solutions for clients.

* Business Process Expertise: Understanding of business processes related to supply chain management, including order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, and inventory management, to drive business outcomes.

title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
description:
**Description**
Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include--but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development & delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End-to-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

title: Franchise Development Manager
description:

WRAPCHICK PIZZA is a fast-growing quick-service restaurant brand in India, offering a wide variety of menu items including pizzas, burgers, wraps, waffles, coolers, shakes, and crispy chicken. The company focuses on delivering a vibrant, contemporary dining experience with diverse options for different tastes and preferences. WRAPCHICK PIZZA is actively expanding its presence through franchising and welcomes partners interested in growing with the brand. The organization values operational excellence, strong customer service, and collaborative franchise relationships, making it an engaging environment for individuals interested in food service and franchise development.

The Franchise Development Manager intern will support the growth of WRAPCHICK PIZZA’s franchise network, working on-site in Kolaghat. This internship role involves identifying and qualifying prospective franchise partners, managing lead pipelines, and assisting with initial franchise sales conversations. The intern will help prepare business plans, presentations, and franchise proposals, and coordinate meetings, property visits, and documentation with potential franchisees. * Business Planning skills to support preparation of basic financial projections, market assessments, and franchise proposals.
* Lead Generation skills to source, qualify, and manage potential franchise inquiries through multiple channels.
* Training-related skills to assist in onboarding new franchise partners and supporting initial operational training.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with comfort in client-facing discussions and negotiations.

* Pursuing or having completed a degree or diploma in Business, Management, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.

* Target Achievement: Ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the retail market
* Network Management: Manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones
* Stakeholder Engagement: Motivate distributors, dealers, and retail chemists through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes
* Strategic Meetings & Collections: Organize distributor and retail dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups
* Market Intelligence: Act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities in the retail space, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your visits

**Who You Are**

* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field
* You have proven practical experience in pharmacy sales, distribution management, or a territory management role
* Product Expertise: You bring highly preferred experience working with OTC (over-the-counter) and/or OTX (Over-the-Counter and Prescription) pharmaceutical products
* You have a strong interest in driving retail market growth, with a focus on pharmacy relationship building, demand generation, and executing in-store marketing strategies
* You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Chemist, dealer, and Doctor interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings
* You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/weekly/monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections
* You are comfortable with field travel within the Kolkata territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: Senior Account Manager Conglomorate
description:
**Description**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the pioneer in Cloud Computing and recognized among the world’s largest and most innovative global enterprises. Our breadth of cloud services are used by hundreds of thousands of developers and businesses around the world. Indian Enterprises are going through a paradigm shift in how they innovate and reinvent themselves in the digital-first world. Adoption of cloud has become a key enabler of this journey.
  
  
AWS has helped a number of companies, across diverse industries, achieve resiliency, scale, agility and drive better customer engagement. We are looking for a seasoned leader with business background, technical depth, and excellent communication skills capable of mentoring an experienced team of sales leaders who are helping some of our large Indian Conglomerates continue to innovate, transform and grow their business, leveraging AWS.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This leader will bring deep and strong C-level relationships with influencers (in business and IT / CIO functions across enterprise levels) to help further establish Amazon as the leader in enterprise cloud computing.
  
  
Towards this goal, s/he will be leading a pan-India team of sellers and partner closely with AWS - Solution Architect teams, Partner teams, Marketing, Enterprise support and Proserv teams to drive tangible business outcomes for our large Conglomerate customers.
  
  
We are looking for a self-starter who is prepared to own, define, develop and execute a geographic plan to consistently deliver on quarterly revenue targets/ quota.
  
  
This leader would report into the Head of Conglomerates, AWS India.

The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of sales operations or equivalent experience

* Experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service, or experience in managing and troublshooting network and experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities

title: AVP Premier Relationship Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Descriptor**
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
  
  
**Wealth and Personal Banking (WPB)**
is our new global business combining Retail Banking and Wealth Management; and Global Private Banking, to become one of the world’s largest global wealth managers with USD1.4 trillion in assets. Across Asia, where wealth pools are growing faster than in any other region, HSBC’s wealth revenues grew 12% in 2019 (year-on-year) to USD5.7 billion. Our dedicated colleagues serve millions of customers worldwide across the entire spectrum of private wealth, ranging from personal banking individuals and families, through to business owners, investors and ultra-high-net-worth individuals. We provide products and services such as bank accounts, credit cards, personal loans and mortgages, as well as asset management, insurance, wealth management and private banking that best suit our customers’ needs.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the WPB team.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The PRM & SPRM role are client facing roles. Playing a integral part of HSBC RBWM flagship offering of ‘’Premier Banking’’ To grow and nurture HSBC Premier relationships (High Networth Individual) segment of the Personal Banking customer base) and achieve business targets as laid down and in accordance with the business plan To facilitate a single point of contact for all Premier customers, anticipate needs and provide required banking/financial advisory services. The jobholder to ensure that high quality customer service is provided to customers in line with Global Premier Service Standards. The identification of opportunities for wealth reviews and delivering wealth solutions as an adviser are amongst the key activities to achieve your goals as complied with local regulatory requirement.
  
  
All this needs to be achieved by keeping the highest standards of integrity towards the bank and clients and the regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities**
**Impact on the Business / Function**

* Maximize profit and achievement of the growth of Premier clients portfolio
* Achieve agreed financial targets by development of existing and new relationships
* Build effective relationships with clients to retain and develop sustainable relationships
* Complete regular reviews with clients to understand their current and long term needs and advise them on the products and services that help them achieve their goals
* Effective use of tools and information to drive client service delivery and performance
* Maintain a minimum standard of qualifying Premier clients within portfolio as stated by Group
* Build a high personal and corporate profile in the community in which you are based. Develop network of Group and External professional contacts with the aim of introducing new business, enhancing technical knowledge and promoting the brand
* Monitor and act on daily sales activity management information and other internal information tools, using them to coach the wider Branch team in support of business goals
* Establish and agree client contact strategies in line with Group operating models
* Fully utilize and input to Client Relationship Management data, ensuring all client information is complete and kept up to date
* Demonstrate excellent understanding of client needs, recommend appropriate products and services, and achieve closure of sales

**Customers / Stakeholders**

* Own the client relationship with HSBC
* Maintain a deep understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services available from Group sources and elsewhere in order to provide the best solutions for clients and maximize revenues for Global Wealth and the Group
* Maintain highest standard of excellence in client service across the team and with individual portfolio - Ongoing analysis of client portfolios through marketing of ideas and researching clients
* Monitor client satisfaction data implementing portfolio level improvements
* Work with the broader branch, support and direct teams to ensure achievement of the business performance measures by delivering differentiated products and services to the client

**Leadership & Teamwork**

* To work as part of an integrated branch management team to ensure, standards and are met and operating models delivered
* Proactively support others through direct and indirect actions beyond activities particular to this role
* Collaborate with the wider team to deliver the Branch Performance measures and plan to support the multi-channel client journey
* Establish and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues in the wider businesses and others as appropriate to service client needs

**Operational Effectiveness & Control**

* Ensuring that sales & operations are undertaken in accordance with HSBC Bank and Credit Policy Manual appropriate lending guidelines
* Agree and manage lending facilities within any agreed Approval Authority
* Manage operational risk, by using relevant data to identify risk situations and take any appropriate action to minimize loss
* Adhere to selling process and sales quality requirements
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the Anti Money Laundering and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional Offices / Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated
* Requesting additional training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of Politically Exposed People acceptance, prohibition, guidelines in order to ensure that is fully compliant
* Understand the relatively high reputational risk that arises from any perceived weaknesses in controls in respect of substantial cash deposits or withdrawals activity, wire transfer, monetary instruments and pouch and mail
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same
* Necessary remediation steps needs to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non-adherence to the policy laid down
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile , else raise it to line manager for further clarification
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner
* Ensure adequate due diligence is undertaken by the Individual/team to ensure that the nature of the various transactions of wire transfer, cash services, monetary instruments are in sync with customer profile

**Major Challenges**
The bank seeks to grow business through an efficient operation and the pursuit of providing clients with globally consistent experiences, excellent service, cross selling products and services appropriate to client needs in order to enhance that value. In the face of fierce competition in this segment the bank is seeking to grow the significance of this group in their contribution to our business.
  
  
The Premier segment typically comprises clients with Total Relationship Balances of 25lakhs or more.
  
  
We should also recognize our responsibility to the community in which we operate and improve the bank’s profile within those communities building economic value for the bank and its shareholders.
  
  
The range of competitors and products has established an increased financial awareness in clients, creating demand for increased experience and skill at PRM level.
  
  
**A Premier Relationship Manager Requires The Following Key Attributes**

* Excellent sales and people management skills
* Client driven with a strong focus on quality of service
* Strong interpersonal communication skills
* A strong sense of ownership, responsibility and accountability
* An excellent understanding of financial planning, wealth management and understanding client need

The jobholder forms an integral part of the wider HSBC management team. As part of this wider team the jobholder is expected to identify opportunities in their day to day activities that directly or indirectly contribute to the success of colleagues with differing responsibilities, particularly in other areas of HSBC such as Commercial and Private Bank.
  
  
**Role Context**
The jobholder will own and manage a portfolio of clients with Total Relationship balance of 25 lacs or more
  
  
**The Jobholder Has Prime Responsibility For**

* Maximizing growth in their portfolio and achieving the plan/metrics
* Leading Premier activities to ensure opportunities are identified and client needs are met effectively, maximizing all available resources.
* Compliance with the relevant Group standards including regulatory organization as applied to the implementation of the strategy in their country

Jobholder will hold Lending Approval authorities appropriate to their role.
  
  
The job holder operates within the approved operating and strategic plan process to develop the business.
  
  
**Management of Risk**

* Adheres to processes and controls to identify and mitigate risks and ensures timely escalation of control issues and reputation risks.

**Observation of Internal Controls**

* Maintains HSBC internal control standards and addresses audit points and/or any issues raised by regulators in a timely manner.

**Role Dimensions**

* Portfolio Size of Total Relationship Value of 25 lakhs or more per customer
* Portfolio Size of Premier clients or number of relationships as dictated by market requirements
* Growth in Income, balances, clients volumes, number of clients, etc..

**Qualifications - External**
**Knowledge & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree with relevant experience
* Minimum of 5-8 years of Relationship management work experience with high net worth clients.
* Evidence of strong sales results in insurance and investment products
* Relationship management experience with high net worth clients
* Strong technical skills in wealth management
* Strong communication, client focus and influencing skills
* Strong sales orientation, networking and portfolio management skills
* Sound knowledge of financial services products and services and the client relationship management system
* Understanding of business banking client segment and products and services
* Local regulatory & license requirements - job holder should possess valid licenses with accreditation on wealth management and qualification as required by country
* Clear view on how to work with Compliance, Credit & Risk and Internal Control to ensure a balanced risk operating environment
* Able to communicate well in English and local languages

**Accreditations**

* IRDA (Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority) and AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds) certifications are mandatory

**Leadership Capabilities**

* Have an understanding of the immediate regional Global Wealth strategy and the ability to plan own activities accordingly
* Be ambitious about providing the highest standards of delivery to colleagues and clients
* Show ability to set stretch goals for self and the ability to deliver these with courage and tenacity
* Be authentic and show ability to engage with colleagues and clients to deliver at pace
* Make considered decisions that protect HSBC & Global Wealth values, reputation and businesses

**Technical Capabilities**
**Global Wealth Management - Relationship Manager Technical Capabilities**
**Client Skills**

* Client focus
* Sales orientation
* Portfolio management
* Communicating & influencing

**Business Acumen**

* Marketplace knowledge
* Business understanding

**Solutions**

* Premier products and services
* HSBC services and propositions

**Processes**

* Risk and compliance
* Business processes
* Tools and systems

**Pro-tip :**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  

* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Salesforce Technical Manager - Core Data
description:
**Description**
Salesforce is currently seeking a Manager, Technical Consulting to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. Our Manager, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in managing, training, and building the careers of our technical consulting team.
  
  
In addition to people leadership, career coaching, and project oversight responsibilities for the team, you will build our Core Data practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team.
  
  
This role is 50% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a Data Architect to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s platform and core data fundamentals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* You will be required to deliver technical work (as a data/technical architect) on billable projects at 50% utilization and balance that with leading your team of Technical Consultants/Architects

+ Define and govern the overall data architecture strategy across Salesforce orgs, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with enterprise data standards
+ Own end-to-end data migration strategy and execution — covering discovery, profiling, cleansing, transformation, load, and validation
+ Advise clients on Salesforce object model best practices — standard vs. custom objects, relationships (lookup, master-detail, polymorphic), and schema design
+ Lead decisions on data access patterns, sharing model, OWD, role hierarchy, and field-level security as they relate to data architecture
+ Establish data governance frameworks, data ownership models, and data stewardship practices
+ Design solutions across multi-org, multi-cloud, and hybrid data environments

* You’ll have up to 15 direct reports under your scope of responsibility.
* You’ll be responsible for hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Consultants so they can implement successfully in turning the program design of our Solution Architects and Technical Architects into highest-quality solutions that meets the customers’ needs, ensuring continuous team enablement across modern AI coding environments.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture frameworks that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering model across your delivery team.
* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI elements securely, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Industries Cloud and Experience Cloud, guiding teams on the effective use of AI development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to maintain delivery speed and code health.
* Ensure the success of these teams while securing the highest CSAT and business outcomes, focusing on Performance Evaluation & ROI by defining metric frameworks to measure the business value of client AI workloads.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party stakeholders.
* Champion an AI-first development workflow by utilizing advanced AI developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate Salesforce Field Service solution development, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, mobile application development, and integrations while maintaining platform security, performance, and Salesforce best practices.
* Practical fluency in using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems to maximize development productivity, optimize Field Service solutions, document custom implementations, and deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality customer solutions.
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 10-15 years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors, with a strong data focus.
* 5+ years of people management experience.
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills.
* Proficiency with data integration tools (Informatica, Talend, or similar)
* Solid understanding of SQL, PL/SQL, SOQL, Python, data loading tools, and Salesforce governor limits.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud (formerly CDP)
* Expertise in one or multiples of → Sales/Service/Experience Cloud, Salesforce Industries Cloud (Comms, H&I or FSC OR RCA/RCB) with a foundational familiarity with Agentforce architectures being a plus.
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Integration Architecture (Must have)
* Data360 and Agentblazer Legend
* Architectural Design Patterns
* Sharing and Visibility (Good to have)
* Platform Security (Good to have)
* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security (Good to have)
* Proficiency in English.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Salesforce Certification Preferred (Admin, App Builder, Sales, and Service Clouds, Application Architect)
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, specifically keeping pace with AI-assisted delivery trends and data compliance practices.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration.
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems.
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue.
* Strong interpersonal skills - nurture effective working relationships with others.
* Exceptional analytical skills - experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation metrics, and outcomes.

title: RC FS -BTI INS -Life and Annuity -Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS Business Consulting – Life & Annuity Senior position:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As part of our Consulting team, you will play a key role in supporting clients across the individual and group life insurance and annuity value chain. You will contribute to complex transformation programs by applying deep product, process, and platform knowledge, while helping clients achieve their business objective. This role provides the opportunity to work across multi vendor environments, influence strategic business decisions, and contribute to large scale transformation initiatives for insurance careers.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support clients across the full policy lifecycle, including new business, underwriting, policy servicing, billing, claims, disbursements, and regulatory updates.
* Create comprehensive business process maps, future state architectures, and work breakdown structures (WBS) for conversion and transformation programs.
* Lead requirements elicitation through JAD sessions, workshops, and collaboration with product owners to develop BRDs, FSDs, and other documentation.
* Challenge new requirements and change requests by proposing optimized, value driven solutions that align with business strategy and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with product design and development teams to evaluate functional enhancements and ensure they meet business objectives.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Senior Manager in FAAS Managed Services, you will lead pre-sales solutioning, large-scale pursuits, and commercial strategy, enabling successful deal closure and supporting revenue growth across markets.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead F&A pre-sales, solutioning, and client enablement initiatives aligned to growth priorities

* Act as deal/pursuit owner, leading end-to-end responses for RFI, RFP, and RFQ processes
* Drive the full pursuit lifecycle including:

+ Opportunity assessment and qualification
+ Solution structuring and proposal development
+ Executive story lining and value articulation
+ Pricing and commercial modelling

* Coordinate effectively between internal and external stakeholders to enable successful deal closure
* Lead solution defence sessions, presenting EY’s differentiators and value propositions
* Support client meetings, orals, and demonstrations, including POC and solution walkthroughs
* Lead or support due diligence exercises where required
* Develop and implement commercial strategies aligned with deal objectives and growth targets
* Design and execute pricing approaches including:

+ Outcome-based pricing models
+ Time & Material (T&M) pricing
+ Hybrid pricing structures

* Ensure pricing is competitive, profitable, and supported by strong business justification
* Align pricing with internal delivery capability, cost models, and margin expectations
* Support negotiation strategies and commercial structuring for complex engagements
* Support mitigation of challenges across existing engagements and ensure continuity
* Ensure seamless alignment between pre-sales commitments and delivery execution capability
* Work closely with external auditors to support timely and successful completion of F&A reconciliation audits (where applicable)
* Enable smooth transition from deal closure to implementation
* Collaborate with:

+ Onshore partners and account leadership
+ Sales and business development teams
+ Delivery teams for feasibility and costing
+ External stakeholders and client leadership

* Deliver compelling, tailored presentations to clients showcasing solution benefits and differentiation
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders to support pursuit success and long-term growth
* Lead solution presentations, demos, and executive discussions at senior/partner levels
* Manage, mentor, and performance manage direct and indirect solutioning team members
* Build and develop a strong pipeline of pre-sales and solutioning talent
* Drive knowledge sharing, capability building, and best practice standardization across teams

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong expertise in pre-sales solutioning, bid management, and pursuit leadership
* Deep functional knowledge across F&A processes (P2P, R2R, O2C, Treasury, Tax, Reconciliation)
* Proven ability to lead large, complex RFP and solution defence engagements
* Strong commercial acumen with experience in pricing strategy and financial modelling
* Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive decision-making

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Experience in managed services, consulting, or large transformation programs
* Exposure to global clients and multi-region delivery models
* Experience in digital transformation, automation, or robotics initiatives
* Familiarity with KPI/SLA and outcome-based delivery models

**What We Look For**
We are looking for individuals with 12–15 years of experience in Finance & Accounting, with exposure across multiple areas, strong commercial mindset, solution-driven thinking, and leadership capabilities, who can drive high-impact pursuits and influence outcomes. The ability to manage complexity, engage stakeholders, and deliver client-centric solutions is critical in this role.

Candidates must have personally configured Salesforce CPQ and must have practical, hands\-on experience building AI agents.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Quote\-to\-Cash Solution Design: Map and optimize the end\-to\-end sales journey, covering account creation/validation, opportunity management, quote generation, contract finalization, and order confirmation.
* Salesforce CPQ Architecture and Configuration: Design and maintain complex bundle structures (components vs. accessories), subscription/term\-based pricing models, renewal logic, and Quote Line Editor product/validation rules.
* Account Onboarding, MDM \& Routing: Design account creation and approval workflows. Configure territory and user routing based on geography, revenue, and employee headcount.
* Integration \& Data Architecture: Partner with engineering teams to define integration specs between Salesforce CPQ, Master Data Management (Informatica MDM), middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi), and downstream invoicing engines. Define the Salesforce and Informatica MDM integration for account validation, enrichment, and deduplication. This includes resolving conflicts between third\-party data (ZoomInfo, D\&B, SEC) and existing MDM records.
* Data \& Technical Validation: Write SOQL queries to analyze data models, troubleshoot configuration edge cases, and validate data migrations/enrichment pipelines.
* AI \& Emerging Tech: Assist in evaluating and setting up native AI capabilities (e.g., Salesforce Agentforce, sub\-agents) to automate internal workflows and user journeys.
* Agile Story Authoring: Write detailed user stories, process flow diagrams, and acceptance criteria while partnering with offshore development teams to drive sprint execution.


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience: 8\+ years of experience in the Salesforce ecosystem, with at least 4\+ years dedicated to Salesforce CPQ (SteelBrick) implementation and business analysis.
* CPQ Expertise: Hands\-on mastery of Salesforce CPQ configurations—including complex product rules, pricing waterfalls, price rules, and subscription management.
* Integration Knowledge: Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns, REST/SOAP APIs, and tools such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica MDM.
* Technical Acumen: Ability to write SOQL queries, read APEX data structures, and understand complex object relationships within Salesforce.
* Process Mastery: Deep functional understanding of Quote\-to\-Cash, SaaS billing models, and contract lifecycle workflows.
* Emerging AI: Exposure to or strong foundational knowledge of Salesforce Agentforce and AI agent configurations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist.
* Experience in enterprise SaaS, cloud, or subscription\-first technology companies.

Over the next three to four years, Sturlite will grow into a multi\-category electrical group of ₹2,000 Cr\+ — built on four legs: lighting, wires \& cables, switchgear \& MCBs, and wiring devices. \*\*The team being built for the Power Division defines this next chapter. The Power Division is being built once. The people who build it own how it gets built.\*\* \*\*The Opportunity\*\*


**Role**
 This is not a maintenance role in an established business. It is a state P\&L leadership role in a brand\-new category. The right candidate will:
   

  

 \_
   

  

* \_Enter a market where Sturlite Power has zero legacy baggage — no old pricing issues, no burned relationships, no stuck stock. \_
* \_Leverage Sturlite's existing lighting dealer network (16,000\+ partners) as a ready entry point for distributor and retailer conversations. \_

* \_Assign zone territories, set targets, build beat plans; conduct joint market visits and weekly reviews. \_

* \_Build a team culture of ownership, field discipline, and commercial accountability from Day 1\. \*\*3\\. Distributor Strategy \& Channel Health\*\* \_
* \_Own distributor strategy for the state — appointment, ROI management, performance reviews, conflict resolution. \_
* \_Map the state's electrical wholesale and distribution landscape; identify and prioritise the right distributor profile for Sturlite Power. \_

* \_Activate key electrical wholesale hubs — establish Sturlite Power as a visible, credible option at the counter within the first 90 days. \*\*4\\. Sumangal Electrician Programme — State Execution\*\* \_

* \_RSM is the sole authority for kitty deployment; ASM and below have no scheme authority. \_
* \_Kitty quantum is set annually by the BU Head; RSM is accountable for ROI (target: ≥ ₹15 of incremental billing per ₹1 deployed). \*\*6\\. Demand Planning \& Supply Coordination\*\* \_
* \_State\-level demand planning and forecasting; coordinate with manufacturing for monthly supply allocation. \_
* \_Drive new SKU launches and sub\-brand traction — sampling, dealer education, electrician demos. \_
* \_Represent Sturlite at state trade bodies, BIS audits, and electrical contractor associations. \*\*7\\. Brand Visibility \& Market Intelligence\*\* \_
* \_Drive in\-shop visibility — ensure branding materials, product samples, price lists, and display boards are in place at key retail counters. \_
* \_Track competitor activity closely — Polycab, Finolex, KEI, RR Kabel, Havells — monitor pricing, schemes, new launches, and distributor moves in the state. \_
* \_Provide monthly market intelligence reports to the Joint BH team; flag opportunities and threats in real time. \*\*Key Performance Indicators\*\* \_\_\*\*KPI\*\*

**Job Description:**
**Role \- Key Account Manager \- Oncology:**
**Location \- Kolkata:**
**OBJECTIVES / PURPOSE:**
* Lead and orchestrate a cross\-functional account team to deliver the Key account plan.
* Grow revenue and market share and meet or exceed targets of Takeda oncology portfolio in assigned key accounts by tailoring resources and engagement to a deep understanding of customer needs and local context.
* Maintain expert\-level disease/therapy, product, competitor and ecosystem knowledge; capture and share insights and flex channels to maximize customer engagement.
* Act as a budget holder, making sound business decisions that benefit patients and the company while adhering to all applicable codes, laws and internal policies.


**SCOPE:**
* Financial Revenue/budget accountability as applicable to the role.
* Leadership / People Individual contributor; leads cross\-functional/account teams without formal line authority. Direct reports 0\.
* Geographic scope Regional \- Intercontinental; India/Kolkata


**ACCOUNTABILITIES:**
* Build integrated account plans aligned to brand and access strategies; set clear objectives, KPIs and regular review cycles.
* Develop deep account and stakeholder maps; identify decision pathways and influence points across the ecosystem.
* Track performance, risks and opportunities; adjust tactics dynamically and lead the account team to deliver outcomes.
* Conduct peer\-to\-peer\-like engagements with HCPs (including balanced scientific discussions) to align on shared objectives.
* Uncover underlying customer motivations; capture them accurately in CRM and use them to tailor subsequent interactions and content.
* Demonstrate resilience, assertiveness and persistence to overcome access barriers with busy specialists who have long\-standing competitor relationships.
* Question entrenched treatment norms and highlight unmet needs using patient\-centric storytelling that differentiates the brand and drives consideration.
* Proactively tailor content, cadence and channel to each HCP's preferences, deploying the optimal mix of face\-to\-face, real\-time virtual and omnichannel tactics.
* Use CRM and AI\-enabled tools to prioritize accounts, plan interactions and adapt quickly based on data; produce measurable engagement/outcome reports.
* Systematically capture, structure and share field insights; translate them into next\-best\-actions and account strategy updates.
* Leverage dashboards and analytics to refine targeting, optimize resource allocation and focus on the highest\-value opportunities.
* Single point of accountability for orchestrating the cross\-functional account team without formal line authority.
* Combines commercial acumen, scientific credibility and customer insight to differentiate Takeda in competitive specialty markets.
* Acts as a budget holder, balancing patient benefit, business value and compliance in every decision.


***DIMENSIONS AND ASPECTS* 
 :**
**Technical/Functional (Line) Expertise:** 
*(Breadth and depth of knowledge, application and complexity of technical knowledge)*
 Solid, experienced commercial and account\-management expertise, with strong knowledge of Oncology/Hematology, the local healthcare and reimbursement system, and Takeda's products, competitors and the customer ecosystem. Applies omnichannel engagement, CRM and analytics to drive performance.
   

  

**Leadership:** 
*(Vision, strategy and business alignment, people management, communication, influencing others, managing change)*
 Demonstrates strong self\-leadership and leads through influence and example, guiding cross\-functional and account partners toward shared goals without formal authority. Supports less\-experienced colleagues and adapts positively to change. Lives and role\-models Takeda's six culture pillars (Patient\-Centric, People\-Minded, Respectful \& Collaborative, Decision Effectiveness, Performance Culture and Enterprise Orientation).
   

  

**Decision\-making and Autonomy:** 
*(The capacity and authority to make organizational decisions, autonomy in decision\-making, complexity of decisions, impact of decisions, problem\-solving)*
 Works with autonomy within established guidelines; makes and is accountable for decisions within own territory / account scope that affect account and customer outcomes. Applies Takeda's decision framework, balancing Patient, Trust, Reputation and Business priorities, and understands decision roles (Decide / Advise / Inform). Debates then commits, decides with the information available and acts with speed while staying within risk and compliance boundaries.
   

  

**Interaction:** 
*(The span and nature of one's engagement with others when performing one's job, internal and external relationships)*
 Extensive internal collaboration with Medical, Market Access, Marketing and Compliance, and external engagement with HCPs, key accounts and decision\-makers across the ecosystem.
   

  

**Innovation:** 
*(The required level of scientific knowledge, knowledge sharing, innovation and risk taking)*
 Applies solid scientific and technical knowledge, shares field insights and takes sensible, compliant risks to improve engagement and outcomes. Uses CRM, data, digital tools and AI to prioritise and personalise interactions.
   

  

**Complexity:** 
*(Products managed, mix of businesses, internal and/or external business environment, cultural considerations)*
 Operates in a competitive specialty environment with evolving access conditions, multiple stakeholders and cultural considerations across the relevant geography.
   

  

**Performance Culture:** 
*(Ambitious goals, accountability, speed and delivery of measurable results)*
 Sets ambitious personal goals, takes ownership of results, works with pace and delivers measurable outcomes for patients and the business.
   

  

**Enterprise Orientation:** 
*(Cross\-functional and cross\-geography collaboration, sharing best practice, enterprise\-first mindset)*
 Collaborates across functions and geographies, shares insights and best practice, and supports enterprise success beyond own territory.
   

  

**EDUCATION, BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS:**
* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, business or a related field (Master's/MBA desirable).
* Pharmaceutical/specialty sales or key account management experience.
 **Prior experience in Oncology/Hematology sales preferred.:**
* Proven ability to lead through influence and orchestrate cross\-functional teams without formal authority.
* Strong knowledge of the relevant therapeutic area and the local key accounts/territory assigned.
* Account planning, negotiation, analytical, omnichannel and CRM skills.
* Fluency in the local language and good command of English; full compliance and ethical mindset.

 IND \- Kolkata

 Employee

title: ServiceNow Architect -SOMT-Manger
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-ServiceNow Technical Architect \- Telecom Sales \& Order Management (SOMT) \& Integrations**
 As part of EY GDS\-ServiceNow team, you will be solving client problems using the ServiceNow platform. You will get the opportunity to work with a high\-performing team and drive innovative solutions that address complex client needs.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a hands\-on ServiceNow Technical Architect with deep expertise in Telecom Sales \& Order Management (SOMT), enterprise integrations, and ServiceNow platform development. The ideal candidate will lead architecture and delivery while actively contributing to coding, configuration, troubleshooting, and mentoring teams. Experience with telecom OSS/BSS ecosystems, Performance Analytics, and AI capabilities is essential.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Architect and deliver ServiceNow Sales \& Order Management (SOM/SOMT) solutions for telecommunications clients.
* Lead discovery sessions, requirements workshops, solution design discussions, and stakeholder reviews.
* Design and implement integrations using REST, SOAP, IntegrationHub, Scripted APIs, and MID Servers with external OSS/BSS, CRM, ERP, billing, and inventory systems.
* Remain hands\-on by configuring and developing ServiceNow solutions, including Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, Flow Designer, Catalog Items, UI Actions, and custom applications.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex platform, integration, and production issues through root cause analysis and technical leadership.
* Lead development teams, conduct code reviews, enforce best practices, and drive technical governance.
* Mentor and train junior developers, providing technical guidance and capability development across the team.
* Leverage ServiceNow AI capabilities, automation, and Performance Analytics to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* ServiceNow SOM/SOMT, TSM, TNI, ITSM, CSM, FSM, CMDB/CSDM, integrations
* Telecom OSS/BSS integration experience.
* Performance Analytics, Now Assist, AI Agents, and Agentic AI solutions.
* Strong communication, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* College degree in a related technology field (Computer Science, Engineering, etc.) or equivalent experience
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* Minimum two (2\) ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications.
* 8\+ years of ServiceNow experience, including architecture, development, and integration delivery.
* Strong hands\-on scripting experience in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Flow Designer, and IntegrationHub.
* Proven experience in telecom order management, order orchestration, fulfillment, and Lead\-to\-Cash processes.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with tools like JIRA, ServiceNow Agile, or equivalent for backlog management
* Exposure to ServiceNow upgrades, platform governance, and release management
* Experience in stakeholder management and client\-facing roles
* Knowledge of ServiceNow’s latest features and roadmap


**What We Look For**
* A team player and Leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem\-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start\-ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work on inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. You’ll quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging assignments and be part of a collaborative environment focused on quality and innovation.
   

  

 Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced professionals
* Opportunities to develop new skills and grow your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: TC - CS - CTM - AppSec - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**CTM Senior Manager – Application Security**
**Overview**
 As part of our Cyber Security team, you will help secure applications and platforms while ensuring seamless development, build, and deployment capabilities. You will be responsible for designing secure software by identifying security use cases during the design and development stages, including emerging risks from AI/ML\-enabled applications. You will work closely with DevOps, architects, developers, and QA teams to build highly reliable and secure products. You will also coach development teams on building a strong security culture and provide recommendations on vulnerabilities, secure development practices, and the responsible adoption of AI\-driven technologies.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for a Senior Manager – Application Security \& DevSecOps to lead high\-impact application security engagements for enterprise clients. You will drive delivery, mentor teams, expand client relationships, and shape practice offerings across Secure SDLC, DevSecOps, Cloud Security, Threat Modeling, and AI/ML security.
   

  

 This role involves enabling organizations to securely adopt GenAI and AI\-driven solutions, ensuring risks are effectively managed while supporting innovation. This is a client\-facing leadership role requiring both strong technical depth and executive\-level communication.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Client Delivery \& Leadership**
* Lead end\-to\-end application security assessments (SAST/DAST/SCA, penetration testing, secure code review, threat modeling).
* Design and implement Secure SDLC frameworks for Agile/DevOps environments.
* Advise CISOs and CTOs on application security strategy, roadmaps, and ROI.
* Manage large multi\-workstream engagements.
* Advise clients on secure adoption of AI/ML and GenAI solutions, including risk assessments, governance, and secure enterprise integration.
* Lead client\-facing engagements to assess and secure AI/ML applications, providing strategic direction on risk management, governance, and mitigation of vulnerabilities such as prompt injection and data exposure.


**Practice Development**
* Develop proprietary methodologies, accelerators, and IP in AppSec (e.g., AI\-driven secure coding, intelligent vulnerability prioritization, zero\-trust application architecture).
* Contribute to thought leadership — whitepapers, webinars, conference talks (Black Hat, RSA, OWASP).
* Support proposal development and deal closure for strategic pursuits.
* Build and enhance AI security offerings, including GenAI security frameworks and AI risk governance models.


**People \& Team Leadership**
* Mentor and performance\-manage a team of 20–25 consultants (Managers, Seniors, Analysts).
* Build high\-performing, diverse teams with a focus on technical excellence and client empathy.
* Drive utilization, training, and career development.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Experience building enterprise\-scale AppSec and DevSecOps programs from the ground up.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI technologies and their application in enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of AI/ML security risks (model poisoning, prompt injection, data leakage, adversarial attacks) and mitigation techniques.
* Familiarity with secure AI adoption practices, including governance, model lifecycle security, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience contributing to thought leadership, research, or open\-source initiatives in application security.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, NIST SSDF).
* Executive presence — ability to influence CxOs and translate complex technical risks into business outcomes.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* BE / B.Tech / MCA.
* Minimum of 12\+ years of experience in application security, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, or security architecture.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Prior experience in a Big 4 or similar consulting environment as a Manager / Senior Manager.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

description:
